nodes.label: Observation quality / coverage score
nodes.rationale: Low coverage means incomplete picture, never evidence of low fire risk; reduced for rainy days.

nodes.label: Simulated seam test (2017-01, status GOOD)

nodes.label: Seven-day calibrated hotspot probability (VERY_HIGH, 93%)
nodes.rationale: Regional p = 1 - prod(1-p_cell)^alpha (alpha 0.73); cell probabilities never averaged; Brier 0.097, ROC-AUC 0.920.

nodes.label: Harmonized VIIRS-equivalent fire record
nodes.rationale: MODIS (1 km) and VIIRS (375 m) counts are not equivalent and never summed; MODIS is calibrated to S-NPP VIIRS to fill gaps, estimates flagged as statistical.

nodes.label: MODIS orbit drift exclusion (>0.25 h overpass shift)
nodes.norm_label: modis orbit drift exclusion (>0.25 h overpass shift)
nodes.rationale: Terra 2023-2026 and Aqua 2024-2026 excluded from calibration because diurnal sampling differs from historical MODIS era.

nodes.label: Sensor calibration model y = F*x + a*(empty cells), shrunk to national
nodes.norm_label: sensor calibration model y = f*x + a*(empty cells), shrunk to national
nodes.rationale: Per state/month/day-night ratio F plus additive term a for cells MODIS missed; shrinkage to national values stabilizes sparse states.

nodes.label: Git LFS dataset storage
nodes.rationale: Archives (esp. ~160 MB Suomi NPP VIIRS zip) exceed normal Git limits, so they are tracked with Git LFS.

nodes.label: Barren / Snow and Ice classes
nodes.rationale: Tan/grey/white classes over the Tibetan Plateau, Thar Desert and Himalaya.

nodes.label: Croplands class
nodes.rationale: Dominant yellow class across the Indo-Gangetic plain and Deccan; cropland burning is a major fire source in the region.

nodes.label: Forest classes
nodes.rationale: Green classes concentrated in Northeast India, Myanmar, Western Ghats, Himalayan foothills and Andaman Islands.

nodes.label: MODIS Land Cover Type (IGBP classification)
nodes.rationale: Color palette (yellow croplands, red urban, greens forest, tan/grey barren, white snow/ice, blue water/wetlands) matches the MODIS MCD12Q1 IGBP palette; product identity not stated in image.

nodes.label: Water bodies and Permanent Wetlands classes
nodes.norm_label: water bodies and permanent wetlands classes
nodes.rationale: Dark blue wetland patches visible at the Sundarbans/Ganges delta and coastal areas.

nodes.label: GIBS Land Cover Map (South Asia)
nodes.rationale: Categorical land cover raster from NASA GIBS covering the Indian subcontinent, Tibetan Plateau, Bangladesh, Myanmar, Sri Lanka and Andaman Islands; likely used as auxiliary fuel/vegetation context for fire analysis. No legend in the image.
